reason: Both are fee-based claims management outsourcers. CorVel provides workers' comp, auto, health and disability claims and managed care solutions. Crawford handles claims for insurers and self-insured corporations, and its Broadspire acquisition added TPA services and medical management. Both sell to the same buyers (carriers and self-insured employers) and earn service fees per claim. Crawford is more global and focused on property and casualty adjusting, while CorVel is US-focused on workers' comp managed care. That is a difference in emphasis, not a different business.
